title: Binance Options Will Launch BTCUSDT Monthly Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch BTCUSDT Monthly Options on  2022-11-02 .   Please note:   BTCUSDT Monthly Options are European-style Options contracts. Binance will list BTC-221125 Monthly Options on  2022-11-02 . Thereafter, a new BTCUSDT Monthly Options contract will be listed on the last Thursday of every month.  Please note that there will be no new BTCUSDT Monthly Options listing if the new listing’s expiration date coincides with that of the existing BTCUSDT Quarterly Options contract. The existing BTCUSDT Quarterly Options contract will be considered as a monthly expiry instead. A separate announcement will be made for the launch of BTCUSDT Quarterly Options contracts.  There will be a maximum of three BTCUSDT Monthly Options contracts listed at any time.  Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support!
